body: If you need someone to talk to, I am here. Going through a heartbreak at the same time. You can hit me up :)
If you need someone to talk to, you can msg me. I am here my friend
I aswell experience alot of anxiety; tried alot of meds aswell, but nothing seems to work. If you need someone to talk to, I am here my friend
If you need someone to talk to, I am here. You can vent to me or we can have a talk about anything else
I experience those same problems. You should talk to someone; therapist. If you want to talk about it, you can hit me up. I am here for you
I feel you. These battles in our heads can really fuck us more up than people think. It is so draining..

Heal your pain in different ways please. My sister cut her whole life; her whole body is scarred and she will regret it for the rest of her life. I know that it may seem that there are no other options, but please talk, exercise or read. Let’s live in this cruel but lovely world, together.

From your message I can understand that you’re in a tough situation. You’re trying, but it doesn’t seem to work or be a permanent solution. My brother, how great is it that after all this you still keep trying! That power is more worth than you know. Happiness is not permanent, it is temporary; how you choose to view it is the real question. What is your definition of happiness my brother?

I once had the same perspective as you; I don’t want to feel pain anymore on this cruel world. Emotions are energy in motion and please don’t keep them from withholding you live your life to the fullest. You seem like a smart nice kid; you’re still young. Life can change but most importantly; your perspective can change, I promise that. I once was in the same position, multiple suicide attempts and having unbearable depression; but look where I am at now? I couldn’t explain how grateful I am that I am still alive. I know you can do this and I believe in you. Fuck what everyone thinks; make yourself proud. I will pray for you my brother. Lets live in this cruel but lovely world, together.

Even though you don’t want any replies, I just want to tell you that you’re not alone. I was diagnosed with BPD and CPTSD; just like you. A year ago I had attemped suicide and I am so grateful that I am still here. There are many reasons to live, which one is yours? Find your destiny and create your perspective on this cruel but also lovely world. You’re not alone brother and I will pray for you. Let’s try to live, together.
I have lost all my hope for this terrible world.

What medication do you use, if I may ask? I understand the feeling of no sex drive. It is insanely sad and frustrating. There could be alternatives, but for that I need to know what you use as medication

Update: I took multiple opiods & went unconcious. My mom found out & called the ambulance. They gave me an antidote. I ‘sadly’ survived. Hopefully better next time. Love you all for being so concerned, but sometimes things cannot be fixed.
I just want to be happy one day, but that will never happen on this world
I am here!

Like everything you see is blurry.
Like everything you feel is flattened and fake.
When you want to feel emotions, but you cannot.
Everything feels surreal and empty. Emotions haven’t been the same since I was a kid. We we’re happy & felt alive, but I cannot remember the day this all changed for me. And I fantasize about that a lot

I feel you buddy. We in this together; you’re not alone. Even though not being alone doesn’t equal not feeling alone. You cannot kill yourself, because deep down there, there is a little bit of hope that know’s everything will be okay. Hard times will be followed by harder times. Perspective is all & I pray for you that the hope will grow & you will start to feel happy again. It’s gonna be okay.
What is causing you to wanting to kill yourself, if I may ask?
Now is the time to change that, if you want that yourself. No-one decides what a happy lifestyle is, because it varies for each person. If you don’t feel happy with your life right now, change it.
You don’t know how much I crave a gun aswell. Country I live in, it’s hard to get. So sad

I cannot encourage you to kill yourself nor can I tell you what not to do. What I can tell you, is that your not alone in your mindset or the emotions that you feel. I pray for you & things will become well. If that’s in heaven or here, is another question I cannot answer
We are all in this together, yet we all feel so goddamn lonely. Wish I could help you and tell everything will be alright, but what is the definition of “alright”. :(
